name: Nyx
source:
At first glance, a mad elven woman encountered by [url=/c166841]Rhiannon[/url] on the town streets. [spoiler]She warns that the Man in the Mask cannot be trusted and claims her motives are simple — she merely wants to stop him.[/spoiler]
